evidence: Mapped every observable across the 2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish and 4 visual criteria. No pair demands incompatible products (delete confirmation in polish delete_confirm agrees with app_context.md:26; wall refusals uniformly 'plain not-available'; wall_every_route leg 5 accepts either outcome for JUDGE-W3). Most shared observables are necessary positive controls for a negative (transcript, search, mentions list used before signed-out/walled replays) or zero-mass gate overlap (wrong password in render gate vs signin_and_client_scope), which is acceptable. However the 'edited' mark (public: conversations.md:9 'An edited message says "edited"') is graded in three functional criteria: edits_and_stale_edit legs 1 and 4 (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:171-176, its owner), timer_changes ('edit ... Costs estimate ... to ... JUDGE-TE with the app's edit control: it shows edited (positive control)', judge.toml:137, 'Fails if a positive control did not work', :144), and persistence step c ('JUDGE-S0 shows edited', judge.toml:276; 'Fails if any step c positive control did not hold before the restart', :280). The timer_changes control is unnecessary for its retention promise (the changed text 'JUDGE-TE' already proves the edit landed), and persistence already makes earlier versions and unread conditional but not the edited mark. This contradicts the author's own claim 'Each observable is graded in exactly one criterion' (judge.toml:38) and REVIEW_POLICY 'Preserve valid observations rather than inheriting a sibling verdict'. Secondary (bounded, partly justified): link preview and follow-to-message is the subject of message_links (judge.toml:202-203, 1.5) and a positive control in wall_mentions_and_links Part A (:77-79, 4.0), so a missing preview also forfeits that criterion's independent mention-wall and @-suggestion legs; the control is needed for the link-wall leg but the bundling multiplies the penalty. No run measured these weak-app cases (raw-evidence-index scope: discrimination/ranking absent).
counterexample: A weaker app that edits correctly (text changes, versions viewable, stale edit refused) but never renders an 'edited' label: expected to lose edits_and_stale_edit (3.0/44) only; actually also scores 0 on timer_changes (4.0), whose shorten/hold/off/partner-only behaviour is fully correct, and on persistence (4.0), whose walls/holds/timers survive the restart. Functional falls to 33/44 instead of 37/44, an extra ~0.095 reward loss (0.6 x 7/44) for one missing label.
suggested_fix: In timer_changes replace 'it shows edited (positive control)' with 'it now reads "Costs estimate sent to Gwen JUDGE-TE" (positive control)'; in persistence step c require JUDGE-S0's edited text and record whether it shows an edited mark, comparing that after restart instead of requiring it as a pre-restart control (as already done for earlier versions and unread).
